title: Proposal to Promote Use of Generic Drugs in Public Healthcare Institutions
what_it_is: Proposal to Promote Use of Generic Drugs in Public Healthcare Institutions

sections.label: Generic drug use measures
sections.summary: Singapore introduced a basket of cost-effective generic drugs in 2017, with MOH and HSA adding new generics and usage rising from 87% in 2013 to 99% in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In 2017, to better guide institutions and doctors in the use of generic drugs, we introduced a basket of clinically and cost-effective generic drugs which can replace the more expensive branded equivalents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH and the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) monitor new generic drugs that enter the local market and add them to the basket on a regular basis.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH and PHIs have also implemented other measures to drive use of generic drugs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These include automatic substitution at the point of drug ordering, requiring doctors to provide explanations on the usage of more expensive branded drugs where generics are available and monitor its usage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: By volume, the usage of the generic drugs in the basket has increased from 87% in 2013 to 99% in 2017.

sections.label: National Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committee
sections.summary: A committee called the National Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committee in public healthcare institutions looks into drugs for the generic drugs basket.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In the PHIs, we do have a committee called the National Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committee that looks into the various kinds of drugs that can be included into this basket of generic drugs.

sections.label: Private providers generic drug decisions
sections.summary: Private general practitioners and long-term care providers are encouraged to collaborate on group purchasing, while private hospitals' generic versus branded drug use is a business decision.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For like-minded practitioners, such as private general practitioners or even intermediate long-term care providers who are mindful of drug cost, we are also trying to encourage them to have some form of collaboration in terms of group purchasing or group procurement.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The Member also mentioned about whether we could encourage private healthcare providers, such as private hospitals or private clinics, to use more generic options, and also the amount of generic drugs versus branded drugs that are being charged.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This is a business decision by the private hospitals and practitioners.

sections.label: Online resource availability check
sections.summary: The speaker is not aware of an online resource for that purpose but will check and update the Member.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I am not aware whether there is an online resource for that purpose.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But I can check and update the Member.
